summary: Validated Android Gradle wrapper recovery and release prerequisites. Wrapper JAR integrity/version pinning, Git/EAS inclusion, frozen Yarn install, TypeScript, Python compile, and Expo web preview checks passed. Public backend endpoints currently return 502 due to backend process import-time env failure.

critical.issue: Returning HTTP 502. Supervisor backend logs show import crash: KeyError: 'JWT_SECRET' at backend/mobile_routes.py line 33 (JWT_SECRET = os.environ["JWT_SECRET"]).

integration_issues.issue: Backend API is unavailable through public URL because upstream backend process is failing to boot/reload with missing JWT_SECRET env.

action_items: Fix backend env/runtime boot issue so JWT_SECRET is always present at process startup (or fail fast with explicit config validation before serving).
After backend availability is restored, re-run public URL health checks (/api/ping, /api/health) and key mobile API smoke tests.
Proceed with Save to GitHub for wrapper fix only after confirming backend runtime is healthy in preview environment.
critical_code_review_comments: PASS: frontend/android/gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar SHA-256 matches official Gradle 8.14.3 wrapper checksum.
PASS: gradle-wrapper.properties pins gradle-8.14.3-bin.zip and distributionSha256Sum bd71102213493060956ec229d946beee57158dbd89d0e62b91bca0fa2c5f3531.
PASS: Wrapper JAR is not ignored by frontend/android/.gitignore and is included in EAS-style staged tar archive.
PASS: Deepgram key logic in backend/mobile_routes.py uses admin setting or os.environ.get('DEEPGRAM_API_KEY', '') and no hardcoded API key literal fallback was found.
FAIL: backend/mobile_routes.py imports JWT_SECRET with os.environ[...] at module import, causing backend crash when missing and producing 502 upstream.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Wrapper/EAS prerequisite verification is now codified in pytest and passing (7/7). Public backend URL currently returns 502 due to JWT_SECRET import-time crash in supervisor logs, so end-to-end API health/integration retest is required after env/runtime fix.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: call EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL/api/ping or /api/health -> 502. Backend logs show KeyError: 'JWT_SECRET' thrown during import of backend/mobile_routes.py (line 33). Because this happens at module import, app worker fails to load and ingress returns 502. Mitigation: ensure JWT_SECRET exists in runtime environment before app import/startup and validate config explicitly during boot.
